cases.title: OpenAPI lists the subject-variant endpoints (CRUD, stats, promote)
Owner adds variants A and B to step 1
Listing shows two variants and the test as active
Out-of-bounds weight / subject length / empty subject are 422
A subject with a disallowed phrase fails the compliance check (400)
A multi-line subject (header injection) is refused (422)
At most four variants per step (fifth is 409)
Unsent variants can be deleted (204)
An agent cannot change variants (403)
An agent can read the variant stats (200)
Another workspace gets 404 on list / stats / create
Campaign launches (start date in the future)
Launch assigns every email a variant, split evenly (32 / 32)
Each email carries its variant's subject, personalised
Schedule view shows the variant per email
Below 30 sends per variant no winner is named (insufficient_data)
Promotion is refused before the sample size is reached (409)
Variant A stats: sent 30, unique opened 12 (40%), clicked 3, scheduled 2
Variant B stats: sent 30, opened 6 (20%), replied 2 (6.67%)
Winner by open rate is A once both variants have 30 sends
A variant that was sent cannot change its subject (409)
A variant that was sent cannot be deleted (409)
A manager who does not own the campaign cannot promote (403)
Promoting a variant that is not the winner is 409
Another workspace cannot promote (404)
The owner promotes the winner; the two unsent B emails switch
All remaining unsent emails now use the winner's subject
Already-sent emails (sent history) are unchanged
Stats report the promoted winner
After promotion the test is closed: adding a variant is 409
Email list filtered to variant B shows its 30 sent emails with the B subject
Email list page size is bounded (limit > 200 is 422)
Contact email history carries the subject variant
